title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - WasteProducer
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/WasteProducer. Person or organisation which produces waste from their own activities (source: ISO 24161:2022, clause 3.2.1.6). Subclass of foaf:Agent and saref:FeatureOfInterest (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.1.1.13); foaf:Agent is out of this candidate's scope and carries no properties translated here. No location (not a geo:Feature).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'WasteProducer'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

wasteGenerationRate.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/WasteGenerationRate'. Rate at which waste is generated by a waste producer. Note: in the ontology this property is documented alongside the isProducedBy relationship ('a waste kind is produced by a given waste producer at a given waste generation rate') rather than asserted as a direct saref:hasProperty ground triple on WasteProducer; placed here as the most natural bearer. Optional.
